hindi: “पीछे का छोटा कोप, पहले का बड़ा लाभ” — इसमें पीछे का छोटा कोप अधिक गम्भीर है।
english: “A small revolt later, a great gain earlier” — [in this case] the small revolt later is the more serious.
notes: Opening of a quoted view; no teacher is named and the bare iti is not rendered. kopa = revolt (glossary 8.2). The bracketed [in this case] only links the quoted phrase to the comparison. Sentence continues in unit 2.
lines_deva: अल्पः पश्चात्.कोपो महान् पुरस्ताल्.लाभ इति अल्पः पश्चात्.कोपो गरीयान्
lines_iast: alpaḥ paścāt.kopo mahān purastāl.lābha iti alpaḥ paścāt.kopo garīyān

words.gloss: the treasonable, enemies and forest chiefs

hindi: प्रस्थान किए हुए के पीछे के छोटे कोप को दूष्य, शत्रु और वन के सरदार सब ओर से बढ़ावा देते हैं, अथवा प्रकृतियों का विद्रोह होता है।
english: For one who has marched out, the treasonable, enemies and forest chiefs foster the small later revolt from all sides — or [there is] an uprising of the constituents.

text_flags.why: doubled s: sandhi-less typo for prayātasya (gen. sg. of prayāta)

notes: Syntax: alpaṃ paścāt-kopaṃ is read as the object of samedhayanti and prayātasya (gen.) as 'of one who has marched out'; the draft's first reading (accusative with a participle, 'marched with a small revolt') was dropped at review. 'prakṛti-kopo vā' has no predicate; a bare copula is supplied in both languages. Typo flag on prayātassya is genuine.
lines_deva: अल्पं पश्चात्.कोपं प्रयातस्स्य दूष्य.अमित्र.आटविका हि सर्वतः समेधयन्ति, प्रकृति.कोपो वा
lines_iast: alpaṃ paścāt.kopaṃ prayātassya dūṣya.amitra.āṭavikā hi sarvataḥ samedhayanti, prakṛti.kopo vā

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति में प्राप्त हुए बड़े पहले के लाभ को भी भृत्य, मित्र, क्षय और व्यय निगल जाते हैं।
english: In such a state, even a great earlier gain that has been obtained is swallowed up by servants, allies, losses and expenditure.

text_flags.why: lāham looks like a typo for lābham (lābha, gain), cf. units 1, 4, 7, 8

notes: Possible alternative: bhṛtya-mitra-kṣaya-vyayāḥ as "loss and expenditure on servants and allies" (one compound). labdham is placed with mahāntaṃ lābham in the sense "even a great gain once obtained".
lines_deva: लब्धम् अपि च महान्तं पुरस्ताल्.लाहम् एवं.भूते भृत्य.मित्र.क्षय.व्यया ग्रसन्ते
lines_iast: labdham api ca mahāntaṃ purastāl.lāham evaṃ.bhūte bhṛtya.mitra.kṣaya.vyayā grasante

hindi: इसलिए “पहले के लाभ का अयोग हज़ार में एक है” अथवा “पीछे का कोप सौ में एक है” — ऐसे विचार से न जाए।
english: Therefore he should not march [on the ground that] “the failure of the earlier gain is one in a thousand” or “the later revolt is one in a hundred”.
notes: Literal sense of sahasra-ekīya / śata-ekīya is "of one (part) in a thousand / a hundred"; the reading as odds (one in a thousand / hundred) is the most natural but not certain. Alternatively the sense may be that the risk, however small, forbids marching. The lābhasya-ayogaḥ join is unsandhied in the e-text. "on the ground that" is supplied in brackets; the Hindi "ऐसे विचार से" carries the same link to iti.
lines_deva: तस्मात् सहस्र.एकीयः पुरस्ताल्.लाभस्य-अयोगः शत.एकीयो वा पश्चात्.कोप इति न यायात्
lines_iast: tasmāt sahasra.ekīyaḥ purastāl.lābhasya-ayogaḥ śata.ekīyo vā paścāt.kopa iti na yāyāt

words.gloss: having a needle for a mouth

hindi: “क्योंकि अनर्थ सुई जैसे मुख वाले होते हैं” — ऐसा लोकप्रवाद है।
english: “For misfortunes are needle-mouthed” — such is the popular saying.
notes: sūcī-mukha = "needle-faced"; i.e. misfortunes begin as a needle-point (that is the commonly given sense; the text only says needle-mouthed).
lines_deva: सूची.मुखा ह्य् अनर्था इति लोक.प्रवादः
lines_iast: sūcī.mukhā hy anarthā iti loka.pravādaḥ

hindi: पीछे के कोप में साम, दान, भेद और दण्ड का प्रयोग करे।
english: In the case of a later revolt he should employ conciliation, gifts, dissension and force.
lines_deva: पश्चात्.कोपे साम.दान.भेद.दण्डान् प्रयुञ्जीत
lines_iast: paścāt.kope sāma.dāna.bheda.daṇḍān prayuñjīta

words.gloss: in the case of the earlier gain
one who goes with the army

hindi: पहले के लाभ की स्थिति में सेनापति अथवा कुमार को सेना के साथ चलने वाला बनाए।
english: In the case of the earlier gain he should make the commander of the army or a prince the one who goes with the army.
notes: daṇḍa-cārin rendered literally with daṇḍa = army (the force sent out); some take it as "moving in charge of the force". Alternative: kumāra = youth/prince.
lines_deva: पुरस्ताल्.लाभे सेना.पतिं कुमारं वा दण्ड.चारिणं कुर्वीत
lines_iast: purastāl.lābhe senā.patiṃ kumāraṃ vā daṇḍa.cāriṇaṃ kurvīta

words.gloss: capable of restraining a later revolt

hindi: अथवा बलवान राजा, जो पीछे के कोप को रोकने में समर्थ हो, पहले के लाभ को लेने के लिए जाए।
english: Or a strong king, capable of restraining a later revolt, should march to take the earlier gain.
lines_deva: बलवान् वा राजा पश्चात्.कोप.अवग्रह.समर्थः पुरस्ताल्.लाभम् आदातुं यायात्
lines_iast: balavān vā rājā paścāt.kopa.avagraha.samarthaḥ purastāl.lābham ādātuṃ yāyāt

hindi: भीतरी कोप की आशंका होने पर आशंकित लोगों को साथ लेकर जाए, अथवा बाहरी कोप की आशंका होने पर इनके पुत्र और पत्नी को साथ लेकर जाए।
english: On suspicion of internal revolt he should march taking the suspected [men] with him; or, on suspicion of external revolt, [taking] the sons and wife of these.
notes: Second half has no verb of its own; "taking" is supplied (bracketed in English; Hindi repeats the verb of the first half). putra-dāra is a singular collective dvandva ("son and wife"), rendered "sons and wife".
lines_deva: अभ्यन्तर.कोप.शङ्कायां शङ्कितान् आदाय यायात्, बाह्य.कोप.शङ्कायां वा पुत्र.दारम् एषाम्
lines_iast: abhyantara.kopa.śaṅkāyāṃ śaṅkitān ādāya yāyāt, bāhya.kopa.śaṅkāyāṃ vā putra.dāram eṣām

hindi: भीतरी रोक करके, अनेक सेना-वर्गों और अनेक मुख्यों वाले शून्यपाल को स्थापित करके जाए, अथवा न जाए।
english: Having made restraint of the internal [revolt] and having installed a regent with many troop-groups and many chiefs, he should march — or he should not march.
notes: abhyantara-avagraha: "restraint of the internal (revolt/persons)"; the noun is not stated. aneka-bala-varga / aneka-mukhya are taken as bahuvrīhi qualifying the regent (śūnya-pāla); they could also be separate accusatives ("the regent, many troop-groups and many chiefs"). "na vā yāyāt" = "or he should not march" (the alternative of staying).
lines_deva: अभ्यन्तर.अवग्रहं कृत्वा शून्य.पालम् अनेक.बल.वर्गम् अनेक.मुख्यं च स्थापयित्वा यायात्, न वा यायात्
lines_iast: abhyantara.avagrahaṃ kṛtvā śūnya.pālam aneka.bala.vargam aneka.mukhyaṃ ca sthāpayitvā yāyāt, na vā yāyāt

hindi: “भीतरी कोप बाहरी कोप से अधिक बुरा है” — यह पहले कहा जा चुका है।
english: “Internal revolt is worse than external revolt” — this has been said earlier.
notes: The statement is cited back to an earlier passage of the text (not identified here).
lines_deva: अभ्यन्तर.कोपो बाह्य.कोपात् पापीयान् इत्य् उक्तं पुरस्तात्
lines_iast: abhyantara.kopo bāhya.kopāt pāpīyān ity uktaṃ purastāt

words.gloss: of the counsellor, priest, commander of the army and heir-apparent

hindi: मन्त्री, पुरोहित, सेनापति और युवराज में से किसी एक का कोप भीतरी कोप है।
english: The revolt of any one of the counsellor, the priest, the commander of the army and the heir-apparent is internal revolt.
notes: mantra- is literally "counsel"; "counsellor" (mantrin) is taken from unit 20 (mantry-ādi). Four persons, as senā-pati and yuva-rāja are read as separate members. Review: the e-text prints mantra- (not mantri-) here and in unit 19, while unit 20 has mantry-ādi; mantra- may be a typo for mantri- (counsellor). No text_flag was made by the draft (patches cannot add one).
lines_deva: मन्त्र.पुरोहित.सेना.पति.युव.राजानाम् अन्यतम.कोपो ऽभ्यन्तर.कोपः
lines_iast: mantra.purohita.senā.pati.yuva.rājānām anyatama.kopo 'bhyantara.kopaḥ

words.gloss: by the sway of another's power and offence

hindi: उसे अपने दोष के त्याग से, अथवा दूसरे की शक्ति और अपराध के वश से साध ले।
english: He should win him over by abandoning his own fault, or by the sway of another’s power and offence.
notes: Compound para-śakti-aparādha-vaśena is obscure and is rendered literally; para-śakti may be "an enemy’s power", and the compound may be read "by making him subject to (the king’s) power in case of his offence". Alternative sense of sādhayet: "should settle/subdue".
lines_deva: तम् आत्म.दोष.त्यागेन पर.शक्त्य्.अपराध.वशेन वा साधयेत्
lines_iast: tam ātma.doṣa.tyāgena para.śakty.aparādha.vaśena vā sādhayet

words.gloss: in the case of the priest
in the case of the heir-apparent

hindi: पुरोहित के बड़े अपराध में भी रोक रखना अथवा अवस्रावण सिद्धि है; युवराज के विषय में, जब कोई दूसरा गुणवान पुत्र हो, रोक रखना अथवा निग्रह।
english: Even for a great offence by the priest, confinement or avasrāvaṇa is the accomplishment; in the case of the heir-apparent, confinement or restraint, if there is another qualified son.

text_flags.why: possible: m for ṃ; the e-text writes anusvāra as m here, cf. samrodhanaṃ in the same unit

notes: avasrāvaṇa is obscure (literally "causing to flow down/away"); kept untranslated. "siddhiḥ" is left as the predicate noun "accomplishment" (success); in the second part no predicate is stated. Locative absolute guṇavati anyasmin sati putre. Review: the flag on samrodhanam is weak; both occurrences in the unit have sam- (accepted spelling), so no correction is needed. The Hindi/English are unaffected.
lines_deva: महा.अपराधे ऽपि पुरोहिते सम्रोधनम् अवस्रावणं वा सिद्धिः, युव.राजे सम्रोधनं निग्रहो वा गुणवत्य् अन्यस्मिन् सति पुत्रे
lines_iast: mahā.aparādhe 'pi purohite samrodhanam avasrāvaṇaṃ vā siddhiḥ, yuva.rāje samrodhanaṃ nigraho vā guṇavaty anyasmin sati putre

words.gloss: by the actions of following the seized one and of treaty
from fear of union with the enemy

hindi: पुत्र, भाई अथवा अन्य कुल्य को, जो राजा को पकड़ने वाला हो, उत्साह से साध ले; उत्साह के अभाव में गृहीत के अनुवर्तन और सन्धि के कर्मों से, शत्रु से मेल होने के भय से।
english: A son, a brother or another kinsman who is king-seizing he should win over by energy; in the absence of energy, by the actions of following the seized one and of treaty, from fear of union with the enemy.

text_flags.why: abbhāve looks like a typo for abhāve (absence)

notes: rāja-grāhin: "seizing the king" (aspiring to seize the king or kingdom); rendered literally. gṛhīta-anuvartana is obscure: literally "following (the lead of) one who has been seized"; the dual inst. is read as two actions (gṛhīta-anuvartana, sandhi). ari-sandhāna-bhaya read as fear of his joining the enemy.
lines_deva: पुत्रं भ्रातरम् अन्यं वा कुल्यं राज.ग्राहिणम् उत्साहेन साधयेत्, उत्साह.अब्भावे गृहीत.अनुवर्तन.सन्धि.कर्मभ्याम् अरि.सन्धान.भयात्
lines_iast: putraṃ bhrātaram anyaṃ vā kulyaṃ rāja.grāhiṇam utsāhena sādhayet, utsāha.abbhāve gṛhīta.anuvartana.sandhi.karmabhyām ari.sandhāna.bhayāt

hindi: अन्यों से अथवा वैसे लोगों से भूमि के दानों द्वारा इसे विश्वास दिलाए।
english: He should make him trust, by gifts of land, from others or from those of that kind.
notes: The construction is loose: the ablatives anyebhyaḥ tad-vidhebhyaḥ may express "(as he does) to other such persons" (dative sense, i.e. "by gifts of land such as are given to others of that kind") or "from others". Rendered literally; sense uncertain.
lines_deva: अन्येभ्यस् तद्.विधेभ्यो वा भूमि.दानैर् विश्वासयेद् एनम्
lines_iast: anyebhyas tad.vidhebhyo vā bhūmi.dānair viśvāsayed enam

hindi: उससे श्रेष्ठ, स्वयं पकड़ लेने वाली सेना भेजे, अथवा सामन्तों और वन के सरदारों को; उनके द्वारा विग्रह में डाले गए को छल ले।
english: He should send an army superior to him [and] self-seizing, or the neighbouring chiefs and forest chiefs; [him] set at odds by them he should outwit.
notes: svayaṃ-grāha ("self-seizing") is obscure and rendered literally; it may mean an army that takes him on its own initiative. Whether tad-viśiṣṭa/svayaṃ-grāha qualify daṇḍa or are separate objects is uncertain. vigṛhīta = set at odds/made to fight; the object "him" is supplied in brackets.
lines_deva: तद्.विशिष्टं स्वयं.ग्राहं दण्डं वा प्रेषयेत्, सामन्त.आटविकान् वा, तैर् विगृहीतम् अतिसन्दध्यात्
lines_iast: tad.viśiṣṭaṃ svayaṃ.grāhaṃ daṇḍaṃ vā preṣayet, sāmanta.āṭavikān vā, tair vigṛhītam atisandadhyāt

words.gloss: taking of the prince in disfavour

hindi: निकाले गए राजकुमार को ग्रहण करने के, अथवा परग्राम सम्बन्धी, योग का आश्रय ले।
english: He should resort to the contrivance of taking a prince in disfavour, or to the contrivance relating to another village.
notes: Both aparuddha-ādānam and pāragrāmikam are taken as kinds of yoga (contrivance). ādāna could also mean "seizing" (the prince is seized); pāragrāmika is obscure and rendered literally ("of another village"), sense uncertain.
lines_deva: अपरुद्ध.आदानं पारग्रामिकं वा योगम् आतिष्ठेत्
lines_iast: aparuddha.ādānaṃ pāragrāmikaṃ vā yogam ātiṣṭhet

words.gloss: the counsellor and the commander of the army

hindi: इससे मन्त्री और सेनापति की व्याख्या हो गई।
english: By this the counsellor and the commander of the army are explained.
notes: mantra- = counsellor (mantrin), as in unit 20. "Explained" = the same remedies apply. Review: mantra- (not mantri-) as in unit 12; possible typo, not flagged.
lines_deva: एतेन मन्त्र.सेना.पती व्याख्यातौ
lines_iast: etena mantra.senā.patī vyākhyātau

words.gloss: of those excluding the counsellor and the rest

hindi: मन्त्री आदि को छोड़कर भीतरी अमात्यों में से किसी एक का कोप भीतरी अमात्य का कोप है।
english: The revolt of any one of the inner ministers, excluding the counsellor and the rest, is the revolt of the inner ministers.
notes: antar-amātya is rendered "inner minister" (literally "minister of the inside"); the sense of antar here is uncertain. mantry-ādi-varjānām agrees with antar-amātyānām.
lines_deva: मन्त्र्य्.आदि.वर्जानाम् अन्तर्.अमात्यानाम् अन्यतम.कोपो ऽन्तर्.अमात्य.कोपः
lines_iast: mantry.ādi.varjānām antar.amātyānām anyatama.kopo 'ntar.amātya.kopaḥ

hindi: वहाँ भी यथायोग्य उपायों का प्रयोग करे।
english: Even there he should employ the means as is fitting.
lines_deva: तत्र-अपि यथा.अर्हम् उपायान् प्रयुञ्जीत
lines_iast: tatra-api yathā.arham upāyān prayuñjīta

words.gloss: of the country-chief, frontier officer, forest chief and the one submitting with his army

hindi: राष्ट्र के मुख्य, अन्तपाल, आटविक और सेना सहित समर्पण करने वाले में से किसी एक का कोप बाहरी कोप है।
english: The revolt of any one of the chief of the country, the frontier officer, the forest chief and the one who has submitted with his army is external revolt.
notes: Four members taken: rāṣṭra-mukhya, anta-pāla, āṭavika, daṇḍa-upanata (rāṣṭra-mukhya could also be two: country and chief).
lines_deva: राष्ट्र.मुख्य.अन्त.पाल.आटविक.दण्ड.उपनतानाम् अन्यतम.कोपो बाह्य.कोपः
lines_iast: rāṣṭra.mukhya.anta.pāla.āṭavika.daṇḍa.upanatānām anyatama.kopo bāhya.kopaḥ

hindi: उसे एक-दूसरे के द्वारा रुकवाए।
english: He should have him restrained by one another.
notes: anyonyena avagrāhayet is one token (unsandhied join). Sense: have him restrained by one of the others in the group named in unit 22; literal "by one another", medium confidence.
lines_deva: तम् अन्योन्येन-अवग्राहयेत्
lines_iast: tam anyonyena-avagrāhayet

words.gloss: propped up by a very strong fort
of the neighbouring chiefs, forest chiefs, members of his family and princes in disfavour

hindi: अथवा अत्यन्त दुर्ग के सहारे टिके हुए को सामन्त, आटविक, उसके कुल के सदस्य और निकाले गए राजकुमारों में से किसी एक के द्वारा रुकवाए।
english: Or he should have [him], propped up by a very strong fort, restrained by any one of the neighbouring chiefs, forest chiefs, members of his family and princes in disfavour.
notes: atidurga is rendered literally ("very strong fort"); pratiṣṭabdha = propped up / made firm (could also be "obstinate"). "if he is" and "him" are supplied. anyatamena-avagrāhayet is one token.
lines_deva: अतिदुर्ग.प्रतिष्टब्धं वा सामन्त.आटविक.तत्.कुलीन.अपरुद्धानाम् अन्यतमेन-अवग्राहयेत्
lines_iast: atidurga.pratiṣṭabdhaṃ vā sāmanta.āṭavika.tat.kulīna.aparuddhānām anyatamena-avagrāhayet

hindi: अथवा मित्र के द्वारा सहारा दिलवाए, जिससे वह शत्रु के पास न जाए।
english: Or he should have him supported by an ally, so that he does not go to the enemy.
notes: mitreṇa-upagrāhayed and na-amitram are unsandhied joins in the e-text. "him" is the offender of units 22-24. mitra = ally.
lines_deva: मित्रेण-उपग्राहयेद् वा यथा न-अमित्रं गच्छेत्
lines_iast: mitreṇa-upagrāhayed vā yathā na-amitraṃ gacchet

words.gloss: the one who goes with the army

hindi: अथवा गुप्तचर इसे शत्रु से फोड़े — “यह तुम्हें गुप्त पुरुष मानता हुआ स्वामी पर ही आक्रमण कराएगा; अपना प्रयोजन पा लेने पर सेना के साथ चलने वाले को शत्रुओं और आटविकों के बीच कष्ट अथवा परिश्रम में लगाएगा, अथवा उसे पुत्र और स्त्री से रहित सीमा पर बसाएगा,
english: Or a secret agent should cause him to split from the enemy — “This one, thinking you a secret agent, will make [you] attack the master alone; having gained his object he will engage the one who goes with the army among enemies and forest chiefs, in hardship or toil, or will make [him], bereft of sons and wife, dwell at the frontier,
notes: GROUPING: the quotation opened here runs on through units 27 and 28 and closes at "gaccha" iti in unit 28 (the e-text closes it there). amitrāt = "from the enemy" (the enemy’s side); who "this one" (ayam) is, is not stated. daṇḍa-cārin (the person addressed, third person here) rendered "the one who goes with the army". "-" is the dash printed before the quotation. The object of vāsayiṣyati is supplied. Review: amitrāt is taken as the ablative of separation with bhedayet (split him from the enemy); the draft's 'agent from the enemy' was dropped. Doubt remains who 'ayam' is (probably the enemy).
lines_deva: अमित्राद् वा सत्त्री भेदयेद् एनं - "अयं त्वा योग.पुरुषं मन्यमानो भर्तर्य् एव विक्रमयिष्यति, अवाप्त.अर्थो दण्ड.चारिणम् अमित्र.आटविकेषु कृच्छ्रे वा प्रयासे योक्ष्यति, विपुत्र.दारम् अन्ते वा वासयिष्यति
lines_iast: amitrād vā sattrī bhedayed enaṃ - "ayaṃ tvā yoga.puruṣaṃ manyamāno bhartary eva vikramayiṣyati, avāpta.artho daṇḍa.cāriṇam amitra.āṭavikeṣu kṛcchre vā prayāse yokṣyati, viputra.dāram ante vā vāsayiṣyati

hindi: जिसका पराक्रम रोक दिया गया है ऐसे तुम्हें स्वामी के प्रति बेचने की वस्तु बना देगा, अथवा तुम्हारे साथ सन्धि करके स्वामी को ही प्रसन्न कर लेगा,
english: will make you, whose valour is repulsed, an article of trade with the master, or, having made a treaty with you, will propitiate the master alone,
notes: Continues the quotation of unit 26 (the subject is still "this one"). paṇya (literally "article of trade") — sense "a bargaining counter with the master"; rendered literally. bhartari is printed bhartary in the e-text (sandhi before paṇyam without a space; not flagged).
lines_deva: प्रतिहत.विक्रमं त्वां भर्तर्य् पण्यं करिष्यति, त्वया वा सन्धिं कृत्वा भर्तारम् एव प्रसादयिष्यति
lines_iast: pratihata.vikramaṃ tvāṃ bhartary paṇyaṃ kariṣyati, tvayā vā sandhiṃ kṛtvā bhartāram eva prasādayiṣyati

hindi: अथवा उसके मित्र के पास, जो निकट खींचा हुआ है, जाओ।”
english: or go to his ally, [who is] drawn near.”
notes: upakṛṣṭa is obscure: literally "drawn towards"; alternatives "near" or "remote" are possible, so the sense of the whole phrase is uncertain. Closes the quotation of units 26-27; the bare iti is not rendered (glossary). The e-text prints mitram upakṛṣṭaṃ vā-asya, whose order is also possible as "his ally, or the drawn-near one"; kept literal. Review: upakṛṣṭa 'drawn near' agrees with 5.5 unit 14 (the only other occurrence in the layers); 9.6 does not use the word. Sense still uncertain (near / intimate / removed).
lines_deva: मित्रम् उपकृष्टं वा-अस्य गच्छ" इति
lines_iast: mitram upakṛṣṭaṃ vā-asya gaccha" iti

hindi: स्वीकार कर लेने वाले को इष्ट अभिप्रायों से सम्मानित करे।
english: The one who has accepted he should honour with desired aims.
notes: pratipanna = the one who has accepted (the offer of unit 26-28, as glossary 13.4). iṣṭa-abhiprāya is rendered literally ("desired aims/wishes", i.e. fulfilment of them is probably meant).
lines_deva: प्रतिपन्नम् इष्ट.अभिप्रायैः पूजयेत्
lines_iast: pratipannam iṣṭa.abhiprāyaiḥ pūjayet

words.gloss: of the one who has not accepted

hindi: स्वीकार न करने वाले के आश्रय को फोड़े — “वह तुम्हारे प्रति लगाया हुआ गुप्त पुरुष है।”
english: The refuge of the one who has not accepted he should cause to split: “That man is a secret agent planted on you.”
notes: saṃśraya = refuge / alliance on which he relies; sense of "split his refuge" uncertain. te taken as dative/genitive "to/for you" (planted upon you). The bare iti is not rendered.
lines_deva: अप्रतिपन्नस्य संश्रयं भेदयेद् "असौ ते योग.पुरुषः प्रणिहितः" इति
lines_iast: apratipannasya saṃśrayaṃ bhedayed "asau te yoga.puruṣaḥ praṇihitaḥ" iti

hindi: और गुप्तचर इसे परित्यक्त आदेशों द्वारा मरवाए, अथवा गूढ़ पुरुषों द्वारा।
english: And the secret agent should have him killed by abandoned orders, or by secret agents.
notes: abhityakta-śāsana is obscure ("abandoned orders", literal; sense uncertain). sattrin and gūḍha-puruṣa are both "secret agent" per the glossary. ca-enam is an unsandhied join. Review: glossary 13.3 fixes the compound as 'abandoned orders'; 9.6 unit 29 renders abhityakta alone as 'given up to death' (one sent to his death), so 'orders of one given up to death' is a possible sense. Literal rendering kept.
lines_deva: सत्त्री च-एनम् अभित्यक्त.शासनैर् घातयेत्, गूढ.पुरुषैर् वा
lines_iast: sattrī ca-enam abhityakta.śāsanair ghātayet, gūḍha.puruṣair vā

hindi: अथवा उसके साथ प्रस्थान करने वालों और वीर पुरुषों को इच्छा के अनुसार करने से बुलाए।
english: Or he should summon his fellow-marchers [and] valiant men by acting according to [their] wish.
notes: saha-prasthāyinaḥ and pravīra-puruṣān are taken as two accusatives (the -inaḥ ending is acc. pl.), joined by vā; they could also be one phrase ("valiant men marching with him"). "their" in yathā-abhiprāya is supplied. vā-asya, yathā-abhiprāya-karaṇena-āvāhayet are unsandhied joins.
lines_deva: सह.प्रस्थायिनो वा-अस्य प्रवीर.पुरुषान् यथा.अभिप्राय.करणेन-आवाहयेत्
lines_iast: saha.prasthāyino vā-asya pravīra.puruṣān yathā.abhiprāya.karaṇena-āvāhayet

hindi: उसके द्वारा भेजे हुए लोगों से गुप्तचर कहे।
english: The secret agent should speak to those sent by him.
notes: The words to be spoken are not given in the e-text; unit 34 follows with "iti siddhiḥ". Possible GROUPING/lacuna: a quotation may be missing between units 33 and 34. tena may refer to the man of the previous units or mean "by that [means]". Review: agree that the words to be spoken are missing in the e-text; 34 (iti siddhiḥ) is not a speech. No regrouping.
lines_deva: तेन प्रणिहितान् सत्त्री ब्रूयात्
lines_iast: tena praṇihitān sattrī brūyāt

hindi: यह सिद्धि है।
english: Such is success.
notes: GROUPING: iti siddhiḥ appears to close the section on cases that can be accomplished (siddhi); it may also close the speech of unit 33. Rendered literally.
lines_deva: इति सिद्धिः
lines_iast: iti siddhiḥ

hindi: शत्रु के इन कोपों को उठाए, और अपने कोपों को शान्त करे।
english: He should raise these revolts of the enemy, and quell [those] of his own.
notes: The object of śamayet and the noun with ātmanaḥ (kopān) are understood from the first clause; the Hindi repeats कोपों as the ellipsis cannot be left. para = enemy.
lines_deva: परस्य च-एनान् कोपान् उत्थापयेत्, आत्मनश् च शमयेत्
lines_iast: parasya ca-enān kopān utthāpayet, ātmanaś ca śamayet

hindi: जो कोप उत्पन्न करने अथवा शान्त करने में समर्थ है, वहाँ उपजाप किया जाना चाहिए।
english: Who is able to create or to quell revolt, there secret instigation is to be done.
notes: tatra ("there") is taken to mean "in his case"; the Sanskrit is a relative clause with tatra. tatra-upajāpaḥ is an unsandhied join. kopa = revolt.
lines_deva: यः कोपं कर्तुं शमयितुं वा शक्तस् तत्र-उपजापः कार्यः
lines_iast: yaḥ kopaṃ kartuṃ śamayituṃ vā śaktas tatra-upajāpaḥ kāryaḥ

words.gloss: in the attainment of the result

hindi: जो सत्य-सन्ध है, कर्म में और फल की प्राप्ति में अनुगृहीत करने में तथा विपत्ति में रक्षा करने में समर्थ है, वहाँ प्रतिजाप किया जाना चाहिए; और यह विचार करना चाहिए कि वह कल्याण-बुद्धि है अथवा शठ।
english: Who is true to his pledge and able to favour in action and in the attainment of the result, and to protect in disaster, there counter-instigation is to be done; and it is to be judged [whether he is] of good intent or deceitful.
notes: pratijāpa (prati + jāpa) is rendered literally "counter-instigation"; satya-sandha literally "of true pledge". The closing iti marks the alternative question and is not rendered separately; "whether he is" is supplied. karmaṇi may be "in the undertaking". ca-anugrahītuṃ is an unsandhied join.
lines_deva: यः सत्य.सन्धः शक्तः कर्मणि फल.अवाप्तौ च-अनुग्रहीतुं विनिपाते च त्रातुं तत्र प्रतिजापः कार्यः, तर्कयितव्यश् च कल्याण.बुद्धिर् उत-अहो शठ इति
lines_iast: yaḥ satya.sandhaḥ śaktaḥ karmaṇi phala.avāptau ca-anugrahītuṃ vinipāte ca trātuṃ tatra pratijāpaḥ kāryaḥ, tarkayitavyaś ca kalyāṇa.buddhir uta-aho śaṭha iti

words.gloss: with his party of kinsmen killed
by the punishment for a like fault

hindi: क्योंकि शठ बाहरी भीतरी को इस प्रकार उपजाप करता है — “यदि स्वामी को मारकर वह मुझे सौंप देगा, तो शत्रु का वध और भूमि का लाभ — मेरा दोहरा लाभ होगा; अथवा ‘शत्रु इसे मार डालेगा’ — बन्धुओं का पक्ष मारा जाकर और समान दोष के दण्ड से उद्विग्न होकर मेरा अकृत्य-पक्ष और बड़ा हो जाएगा; अथवा वैसे किसी अन्य के विषय में भी वह शंकित होगा; और इसके एक के बाद दूसरे मुख्य को परित्यक्त आदेश से मरवा दूँगा।”
english: For a deceitful external [man] instigates the internal [man] thus — “If, having killed his master, he hands [it] over to me, I shall have a twofold gain: the killing of an enemy and the gain of land; or else ‘the enemy will kill him’ — his party of kinsmen having been killed and alarmed by the punishment for a like fault, a greater party of the unseducible will be for me; or he will be suspected even in another of that kind; and I shall have one chief of his after another killed by abandoned orders.”
notes: Very obscure passage, low confidence. The speaker of the quotation is taken as the external deceitful man; "me" = speaker. māṃ pratipādayiṣyati has no stated object ("hands it over" is supplied; alternatives: "delivers me [the land]", "presents himself to me"). akṛtya-pakṣa = party of the unseducible (opposite of kṛtya-pakṣa, glossary); bhūyān me could also be read "my greater ...". tulya-doṣa-daṇḍa = punishment for a like fault. Who is the subject of the last śaṅkitaḥ bhaviṣyati (the king, or the internal man) is unclear. cet appears as "cedd" (ced + d, from cet + hatvā in the e-text). iti after āhaniṣyati is unsandhied (āhaniṣyati-iti) and is not rendered; the final iti closes the quotation. anyam anyaṃ = one after another. Review: abhityakta-śāsana as in unit 31 (glossary 13.3 'abandoned orders'; 9.6 abhityakta = given up to death).
lines_deva: शठो हि बाह्यो ऽभ्यन्तरम् एवम् उपजपति - "भर्तारं चेद्द् हत्वा मां प्रतिपादयिष्यति शत्रु.वधो भूमि.लाभश् च मे द्विविधो लाभो भविष्यति, अथ वा शत्रुर् एनम् आहनिष्यति-इति हत.बन्धु.पक्षस् तुल्य.दोष.दण्डेन-उद्विग्नश् च मे भूयान् अकृत्य.पक्षो भविष्यति, तद्.विधे वा-अन्यस्मिन्न् अपि शङ्कितो भविष्यति, अन्यम् अन्यं च-अस्य मुख्यम् अभित्यक्त.शासनेन घातयिष्यामि" इति
lines_iast: śaṭho hi bāhyo 'bhyantaram evam upajapati - "bhartāraṃ cedd hatvā māṃ pratipādayiṣyati śatru.vadho bhūmi.lābhaś ca me dvividho lābho bhaviṣyati, atha vā śatrur enam āhaniṣyati-iti hata.bandhu.pakṣas tulya.doṣa.daṇḍena-udvignaś ca me bhūyān akṛtya.pakṣo bhaviṣyati, tad.vidhe vā-anyasminn api śaṅkito bhaviṣyati, anyam anyaṃ ca-asya mukhyam abhityakta.śāsanena ghātayiṣyāmi" iti

hindi: अथवा शठ भीतरी बाहरी को इस प्रकार उपजाप करता है — “इसका कोश हर लूँगा, अथवा इसकी सेना का नाश करूँगा, अथवा दुष्ट स्वामी को इसके द्वारा मरवा दूँगा, स्वीकार कर लेने वाले बाहरी को शत्रुओं और आटविकों के बीच आक्रमण कराऊँगा — ‘इसकी सेना लगाई जाए, इससे वैर जोड़ा जाए, तब वह मेरे अधीन हो जाएगा, तब स्वामी को ही प्रसन्न कर लूँगा, अथवा स्वयं राज्य ले लूँगा’; अथवा बाँधकर बाहरी की भूमि और स्वामी की भूमि दोनों पा लूँगा, अथवा विरोधी को बुलाकर विश्वास करने वाले बाहरी को मरवा दूँगा, अथवा इसके खाली मूल को हर लूँगा।”
english: Or the deceitful internal [man] instigates the external [man] thus — “I shall carry off his treasury, or destroy his army, or have the corrupt master killed by this [man]; the external [man] who has accepted I shall make attack among enemies and forest chiefs — ‘let his force be attached, let enmity with him be fastened; then he will be under my control; then I shall propitiate the master alone, or take the kingdom myself’; or, having bound [him], I shall obtain both lands, that of the external [man] and that of the master; or, having summoned the hostile [one], I shall have the trusting external [man] killed; or I shall carry off his empty base.”

text_flags.why: the final ṇ looks like a stray character (printing artefact) after the end of the inner quotation; possible typo for grahīṣyāmi" or for grahīṣyāmi" iti

notes: Very obscure, low confidence. Nested quotation: the inner quotation opens at "cakram and closes at grahīṣyāmiṇ" (the e-text has no iti there). sajyatām (from sañj, "be attached/hung/put on") and prasajyatām (pra-sañj, "be fastened on") are rendered literally; cakra is taken as "force" (cf. sva-cakra/para-cakra, glossary 8.4), alternatives: circle/wheel, i.e. set in motion. sva-adhīnaḥ me: "under my control" taken with me as "my"; me bhaviṣyati could also be "will be mine". The persons indicated by asya, anena, bhartāram vary: "his" in the first clauses is the master; this is a guess. baddhvā: the object is not stated ("him" supplied). vā-asya, vā-āvāhayitvā, ca-ubhayam are unsandhied joins. The closing iti closes the quotation and is not rendered.
lines_deva: अभ्यन्तरो वा शठो बाह्यम् एवम् उपजपति - "कोशम् अस्य हरिष्यामि, दण्डं वा-अस्य हनिष्यामि, दुष्टं वा भर्तारम् अनेन घातयिष्यामि, प्रतिपन्नं बाह्यम् अमित्र.आटविकेषु विक्रमयिष्यामि "चक्रम् अस्य सज्यताम्, वैरम् अस्य प्रसज्यताम्, ततः स्व.अधीनो मे भविष्यति, ततो भर्तारम् एव प्रसादयिष्यामि, स्वयं वा राज्यं ग्रहीष्यामिण्" बद्ध्वा वा बाह्य.भूमिं भर्तृ.भूमिं च-उभयम् अवाप्स्यामि, विरुद्धं वा-आवाहयित्वा बाह्यं विश्वस्तं घातयिष्यामि, शून्यं वा-अस्य मूलं हरिष्यामि" इति
lines_iast: abhyantaro vā śaṭho bāhyam evam upajapati - "kośam asya hariṣyāmi, daṇḍaṃ vā-asya haniṣyāmi, duṣṭaṃ vā bhartāram anena ghātayiṣyāmi, pratipannaṃ bāhyam amitra.āṭavikeṣu vikramayiṣyāmi "cakram asya sajyatām, vairam asya prasajyatām, tataḥ sva.adhīno me bhaviṣyati, tato bhartāram eva prasādayiṣyāmi, svayaṃ vā rājyaṃ grahīṣyāmiṇ" baddhvā vā bāhya.bhūmiṃ bhartṛ.bhūmiṃ ca-ubhayam avāpsyāmi, viruddhaṃ vā-āvāhayitvā bāhyaṃ viśvastaṃ ghātayiṣyāmi, śūnyaṃ vā-asya mūlaṃ hariṣyāmi" iti

words.gram: first member of a compound with artham (sandhi i + a = y)

hindi: परन्तु कल्याण-बुद्धि वाला साथ जीने के लिए उपजाप करता है।
english: But the one of good intent instigates for the sake of living together.

text_flags.why: possible: the form jīvy before a following word suggests saha-jīvi-artham as one compound, "for the sake of living together"

notes: Obscure. The form saha.jīvy artham may be sahajīvy-artham ("for the purpose of living together") or saha-jīvin (one who lives together with another, i.e. a dependant) + artham ("for the sake of"); rendered with the first sense, low confidence. Review: saha.jīvy artham shows regular sandhi (i + a = y); the text_flag is a precaution, not a real typo. Sense still uncertain.
lines_deva: कल्याण.बुद्धिस् तु सह.जीव्य् अर्थम् उपजपति
lines_iast: kalyāṇa.buddhis tu saha.jīvy artham upajapati

words.gloss: with the one of good intent

hindi: कल्याण-बुद्धि वाले से सन्धि करे; शठ को “वैसा हो” स्वीकार करके छल ले।
english: With the one of good intent he should make peace; the deceitful one, having accepted “So be it”, he should outwit.
notes: GROUPING: the final "| iti" (iti after the danda) is a closing marker of the passage (possibly of the preceding sections 25-41) and is not rendered, per the glossary rule for a bare closing iti. sandadhīta: "make peace/treaty" (sandhi = peace/treaty). pratigṛhya-atisandadhyāt is an unsandhied join. The quote “tathā” iti is rendered “So be it” with the iti not separately rendered.
lines_deva: कल्याण.बुद्धिना सन्दधीत, शठं "तथा" इति प्रतिगृह्य-अतिसन्दध्यात् । इति
lines_iast: kalyāṇa.buddhinā sandadhīta, śaṭhaṃ "tathā" iti pratigṛhya-atisandadhyāt | iti

hindi: ऐसा जानकर — शत्रुओं से शत्रु, अपनों से अपने, शत्रुओं से अपने, अपनों से शत्रु — बुद्धिमान को चाहिए कि अपनों और शत्रुओं से सदा अपने आप की रक्षा करे।
english: Having understood thus — enemies from enemies, one’s own from one’s own, one’s own from enemies, enemies from one’s own — the self is always to be guarded by the wise from one’s own and from enemies.

text_flags.why: possible: plural -āḥ does not agree with the singular ātmā; rakṣyaḥ (or rakṣyā) would agree

notes: Verse closing the discussion. The first line lists four relations without a verb (danger or protection from the stated source); kept elliptical in both languages, nothing supplied. para = enemy (also "other"). rakṣyāḥ is plural, ātmā singular: either a typo, or rakṣyāḥ refers back to the four pairs; rendered as agreeing with ātmā. "svataḥ pare" = enemies from one’s own (ablative suffix -tas).
lines_deva: एवम् उपलभ्य - परे परेभ्यः स्वे स्वेभ्यः स्वे परेभ्यः स्वतः परे
रक्ष्याः स्वेभ्यः परेभ्यश् च नित्यम् आत्मा विपश्चिता
